verdict.rationale: The docs show an official client with `client.parse.run(input=...)`, which needs only an input, and `client.parse.run_job()` for async jobs, plus Python and Node.js code examples. That points to first-party SDKs with minimal-config defaults. Nothing explicitly confirms typed SDKs, a TypeScript package, or SDK coverage of extract and the rest of the API. Missing for 10: explicit typed-SDK documentation, confirmation of a TypeScript SDK (only Node.js examples are mentioned), SDK examples for extract/split/classify/edit, evidence of full API coverage, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK developer experience.

support.subject: As a developer, official typed SDKs for Python and TypeScript cover the full API — parse, extract, jobs — with sensible defaults

citations.quote: Application code: use the Python, Node.js, Go, or cURL examples below.
